text:
Noah: Quick poll — imagine you're dropped into any city with exactly 90 minutes and zero planning. What's the one tiny adventure you'd go on? totally hypothetical :D
Priya: Street-food sprint. Find the busiest stall and eat whatever they're handing out. :yum:
Marta: Museum hop — even one gallery wing is satisfying. Coffee + sketchbook after.
Liam: Find the highest viewpoint/walk up a hill. Skyline + one proper photo.
Ava: @Noah Paris = patisserie + random bench. Tokyo = coin laundromat vibe?? (yes seriously)
DevBot: Tip: pick neighborhoods within 1–2 transit stops to maximize time. 90 mins goes fast. :robot_face:
Noah: Okay vote with emoji? :thumbsup: food, :art: museum, :camera_with_flash: viewpoint, :coffee: cafe chill, :books: bookstore
Priya: :thumbsup:
Marta: :art:
Liam: :camera_with_flash:
Ava: :coffee:
Sam: If it's raining — used bookstore + vinyl shop combo. @Marta teach me your cafe sketching pls
Marta: Yes! tiny tutorial next week? :raised_hands:
Noah: Results (highly scientific): food 1, museum 1, viewpoint 1, cafe 1, bookstore 1 — ties as always, the Redwood way :grin:
Noah: Thanks y'all — planning a micro staycation this weekend, stealing ideas. Will report back with pics :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
